fichas.title: Display Room Layout Types
fichas.summary: The layout of display rooms depends on the relationship between the collection and its display concept. Open plans suit large, visually autonomous objects and allow free circulation; core-and-satellite layouts use a main orientation room and autonomous side rooms; linear chaining provides controlled circulation and clear orientation; labyrinths allow variable routes; complex layouts combine room-group types; and round tours return visitors to the entrance. The page also maps display concepts to spatial arrangements.

fichas.title: Display Room Dimensions, Viewing, and Readability
fichas.summary: Display and store room size and height depend on the works and collection, with a stated minimum clear height of 4 m. Diagrams give guidance on viewing pictures, passage widths, space in front of display cabinets, field of view, and the readability of labels and commentaries. Several diagram measurements have no unit printed alongside them.
